title: God, these bloody English! Bursting with money and indigestion. Because he comes from Oxford. You know, Dedalus, you have the real Oxford manner.
html_source:
Haines comes from Oxford, England, home of Oxford University, the oldest collegiate research university in the English-speaking world as well as the second-oldest university in the world.

Stereotypically, English men/women from there are wealthy and self-absorbed (as Buck’s jab indicates).

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Again, Mulligan casually holds God’s name in vain.
